strings.doc.veltrava.weighbill.alt: Weighbill in the brass frame of courier van 4: load “Files, Annex C”, weight 2410 kg, seal C-17/44 with the Commission’s round counter-seal. Consignee: Secretariat of the Commission.
strings.doc.veltrava.departures.alt: Split-flap departures board: four day trains, and below them a freshly inserted line – 23:40, Kordon-17, platform 5, train type: empty stock.
strings.doc.veltrava.travel_order.alt: Travel order on grey official paper, stamps and signatures. An addition typed in afterwards reads “Escort, courier van 4” – in the Russian with the note freight, in the German with the note files.
